--- welcome

# Coffee Sourcing Dashboard Survey

Welcome! You are a buyer for a coffee importer. The dashboard shows data on
**600 coffee farms**: the altitude the farm sits at, its size in hectares, the
average age of its trees, how many kilograms it yields per hectare, and the
price per kilogram its coffee sold for at auction. Each farm grows one of five
arabica varietals.

Use the dashboard to explore the data, then answer the questions that follow.

```{r}
sd_next(label = "Start Survey")
```


--- familiarity

<center>
# Section 1 of 3
</center>

# Before You Start

```{r}
sd_question(
  id     = "q_familiarity",
  type   = "mc",
  label  = "Before today, how familiar were you with coffee growing or coffee sourcing?",
  option = c(
    "Not at all familiar" = "none",
    "Slightly familiar"   = "slight",
    "Moderately familiar" = "moderate",
    "Very familiar"       = "very"
  )
)
```

```{r}
sd_next(label = "Continue")
```

## This first one is just to get familiar with the dashboard controls. It doesn't count.

Use the dashboard to answer the following question.



```{r}
sd_question(
  id     = "practice_size_age",
  type   = "mc",
  label  = "Across all farms, how are farm size and tree age related?",
  option = c(
    "Positively related"             = "positive",
    "Negatively related"             = "negative",
    "No relation"                    = "no_relation",
    "Cannot determine from the data" = "cannot_determine"
  )
)
```

```{r}
sd_next(label = "Continue")
```

## Q1 of 6

Use the dashboard to answer the following question.

```{r}
sd_question(
  id     = "q1_altitude",
  type   = "mc",
  label  = "A cooperative is buying land to plant a new coffee plot, and wants the coffee to sell for the highest possible price per kilogram. Based on the data, should they buy land at a higher or a lower altitude?",
  option = c(
    "Higher altitude"                      = "higher",
    "Lower altitude"                       = "lower",
    "Altitude doesn't affect price per kg" = "no_effect",
    "Cannot determine from the data"       = "cannot_determine"
  )
)
```

```{r}
sd_next(label = "Continue")
```

## Demographic information

**We're almost done! We’d like to ask a few final questions about you, which will be used only for analyzing the survey data.**

```{r}

years <- seq(2007, 1930)
names(years) <- as.character(years)

sd_question(
  type = 'select',
  id = 'birth_year',
  label = "**What is your year of birth?**",
  option = years
)

sd_question(
  type = 'mc',
  id = 'gender',
  label = "**What is your gender?**",
  option = c(
    "Female" = "female",
    "Male" = "male",
    "Non-binary" = "non_binary",
    "Transgender" = "transgender",
    "Gender Nonconforming" = "nonconforming",
    "Other" = "other",
    "Prefer not to answer" = "prefer_not_answer"
  )
)

sd_question(
  type = 'mc',
  id = 'ethnicity',
  label = "**Are you of Hispanic, Latino or Spanish origin?**",
  option = c(
    "Yes" = "yes",
    "No" = "no"
  )
)

sd_question(
  type = 'mc_multiple',
  id = 'race',
  label = "**Which race best describes you?** *Select all that apply.*",
  option = c(
    "American Indian or Alaskan Native" = "native_american",
    "Asian" = "asian",
    "Black or African American" = "african_american",

    "Native Hawaiian or other Pacific Islander" = "pacific_islander",

)
```
